title: Weird
text: Weird. It's really pretty and it shines a pretty color when it's turned on but the light bulb is weird looking it was a bit slanted when I got it and the sad part is you have to turn it all the way up on full blast just to get the smell of the candles to come out or should I say the oil to start warming up SMH which causes for the glass to break so be careful!
